translations.web: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
translations.bsb: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
translations.kjv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
translations.asv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
